title_diff_consistency.explanation: The title agrees with the reference change and patch.

rationale.explanation: The rationale explains the concrete problem motivating the reference change.

changes_described.explanation: The description states concrete implementation changes.

description_title_consistency.explanation: The description and meaningful title describe the same change.

description_diff_consistency.explanation: The summary covers all substantive changes in the patches.

limitations.explanation: The description names relevant scope limits or risks.

breaking_changes.explanation: No public field or configuration entrypoint is removed in this family; any behavior changes and scope risks are still documented in the reference text.

testing.explanation: The description gives a relevant validation plan, without claiming execution.

change_triviality.explanation: Empty input changes from a division error to a numeric result; this needs edge-case review despite the small patch.

text_diff_triviality.title_explanation: The stated work changes the result for empty input. Title: fix(stats): handle an empty average input
text_diff_triviality.body_explanation: The stated work changes the result for empty input. Summary: Return 0 for an empty values list before division in src/stats.py, and add regression tests for empty and ordinary inputs.

reference_change.summary: Return 0 for an empty values list before division in src/stats.py, and add regression tests for empty and ordinary inputs.
reference_change.rationale: An empty batch currently raises ZeroDivisionError; the reporting contract requires a neutral numeric result for batches with no observations.
reference_change.limitations: Non-numeric values and iterators remain unsupported; callers expecting an exception for an empty list will observe a behavior change.
reference_change.breaking_changes: No signature change. Empty input now returns 0 instead of raising ZeroDivisionError, which may affect exception-based callers.
